values.description: READ-ONLY: live tunnel. Use only GET requests (store-setting, categories?active=true, menu?available=true, orders). NEVER run Admin Catalog & Coupons writes with this selected — they create Postman Cat / Postman Meal junk on the live menu. Run writes against JALIKUD Local instead. If polluted, restore with: docker exec -it jalikud-api php artisan db:seed --class=MenuSeeder --force
Optional: customer token for read-only order checks. Do not use for writes.
Kept DISABLED on purpose so admin write requests cannot accidentally run against production.
